reason: I already go down to Jbeil once a week and fill the boot, and I see the prices with my own eyes. Sending a list before 2 p.m. every time is a hassle, and I would be trusting strangers with my cash and my groceries.
objection: How do I know they really pay what is on the receipt and don't add a little? And a $2 fee on every bag adds up when money is this tight, plus I have to plan my list the same day.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour I know and trust who has used it for a month and shows me the receipt next to the bag, and the fee dropped to $1 or free on a big weekly bag.
